LAO third-party notices — Apple Silicon prebuilt archive

Audit date: 2026-09-12
Cargo.lock SHA-256: 91c493c29c4ea67f6cda70fb0180799cf4d32c187af9dd053204151d4c18cb42
Rust compiler: rustc 1.98.0 (88d9e12ae 2026-08-18)

The archive contains bin/lao, bin/lao-daemon, install.sh, LICENSE,
source-revision, this file and SHA256SUMS. LAO's own code is MIT licensed;
see LICENSE. Third-party terms below apply to their respective components.

Bundled code inventory
----------------------
The inventory covers the union of normal and build dependencies for lao-cli
and lao-daemon on aarch64-apple-darwin, with default features, from Cargo.lock.
Build dependencies and procedural macros are included conservatively; listing
one does not mean its whole source is linked. Crate sources are unmodified.
Full upstream license/copyright/NOTICE/AUTHORS files are retained below,
including nested native-code notices. Identical texts are stored once and
referenced by number. Alternative licenses remain alternatives; conjunctive
and component-specific obligations still apply. System frameworks (including
Accelerate, Security and CoreFoundation) are supplied by macOS, not this archive.
Rust standard-library and compiler runtime notices are included separately.

MPL-2.0 source availability: option-ext 0.2.0 is unmodified. Its corresponding
source (src/lib.rs, src/impl.rs and original Cargo.toml) is included verbatim below, under
MPL-2.0; the full source package is also available at
https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/option-ext/0.2.0/download . No LAO terms restrict
recipients' rights in that source.

Downloaded separately, not bundled
---------------------------------
These artifacts are fetched by LAO after binary installation. Their notices
are provided here for visibility; they are not part of the Cargo inventory.
* Qwen/Qwen3-4B-GGUF, Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, revision
  bc640142c66e1fdd12af0bd68f40445458f3869b: Apache-2.0 (Qwen team).
  Its upstream LICENSE, including attribution, is reproduced below.
* sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, revision
  1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41: Apache-2.0, as declared in its
  pinned model card. LAO fetches config.json, tokenizer.json and model.safetensors.
  No separate LICENSE or NOTICE is supplied at that revision; Apache-2.0
  terms are reproduced below. Model publisher: sentence-transformers.
* llama.cpp b10280 (61881b1f7), llama-b10280-bin-macos-arm64.tar.gz:
  MIT; upstream project LICENSE reproduced below.
* OpenCode 1.18.25, opencode-darwin-arm64.zip: MIT; upstream project LICENSE
  reproduced below. Its executable/runtime dependencies are not bundled here.
Codex and Claude Code are user-installed external clients, not redistributed.
This audit covers this LAO archive, not redistribution of those separate
runtime archives or a future archive containing model weights.

Audit provenance and refresh
----------------------------
Resolve with cargo metadata --locked --filter-platform aarch64-apple-darwin
and cargo tree --locked --target aarch64-apple-darwin -p lao-cli -p lao-daemon
-e normal,build. Collect license, copying, copyright, notice, unlicense and
authors files recursively from the resolved Cargo source packages. Review
embedded native source notices (including esaxx-rs), not only SPDX metadata.
Missing crate license files were recovered from the crate's .cargo_vcs_info.json
revision upstream: Candle, candle-semantic-router (semantic-router),
number_prefix and pulp-wasm-simd-flag. Exact source URLs appear with the texts.
Include the builder's share/doc/rust/COPYRIGHT-library.html and its referenced
license texts. Reaudit on dependency, feature, target, toolchain or downloaded
artifact changes. package.sh refuses a changed lockfile or compiler until this
notice record is refreshed. This file contains upstream license text, not a
change to LAO's license.

option-ext 0.2.0 unmodified corresponding source: src/lib.rs

mod r#impl;

/// Extension trait providing additional methods for `Option`.
pub trait OptionExt<T> {
    /// Returns `true` if the option is a [`Some`] value containing the given value.
    ///
    /// # Examples
    ///
    /// ```
    /// use option_ext::OptionExt;
    ///
    /// let x: Option<u32> = Some(2);
    /// assert_eq!(x.contains(&2), true);
    ///
    /// let x: Option<u32> = Some(3);
    /// assert_eq!(x.contains(&2), false);
    ///
    /// let x: Option<u32> = None;
    /// assert_eq!(x.contains(&2), false);
    /// ```
    #[must_use]
    fn contains<U>(&self, x: &U) -> bool where U: PartialEq<T>;

    /// Returns the result from applying the function to the contained value if the option is [`Some`],
    /// or returns provided default result if the option is [`None`].
    ///
    /// The `f` argument of `map_or2` is only evaluated  if the option is [`Some`].
    /// The default argument of `map_or2` is always evaluated – even if the option is [`Some`].
    /// Use [`map_or_else2`] to avoid this.
    ///
    /// [`map_or_else2`]: OptionExt::map_or_else2
    ///
    /// # Examples
    ///
    /// ```
    /// use option_ext::OptionExt;
    ///
    /// let x = Some("bar");
    /// assert_eq!(x.map_or2(|v| v.len(), 42), 3);
    ///
    /// let x: Option<&str> = None;
    /// assert_eq!(x.map_or2(|v| v.len(), 42), 42);
    /// ```
    #[must_use]
    fn map_or2<U, F: FnOnce(T) -> U>(self, f: F, default: U) -> U;

    /// Returns the result from applying the function to the contained value if the option is [`Some`],
    /// or returns the result from evaluating the provided default function if the option is [`None`].
    ///
    /// The `f` argument of `map_or_else2` is only evaluated  if the option is [`Some`].
    /// The default argument of `map_or_else2` is only evaluated if the option is [`None`].
    /// Use [`map_or2`] to always evaluate the default argument.
    ///
    /// [`map_or2`]: OptionExt::map_or2
    ///
    /// # Examples
    ///
    /// ```
    /// use option_ext::OptionExt;
    ///
    /// let k = 23;
    ///
    /// let x = Some("bar");
    /// assert_eq!(x.map_or_else2(|v| v.len(), || 2 * k), 3);
    ///
    /// let x: Option<&str> = None;
    /// assert_eq!(x.map_or_else2(|v| v.len(), || 2 * k), 46);
    /// ```
    #[must_use]
    fn map_or_else2<U, F: FnOnce(T) -> U, D: FnOnce() -> U>(self, f: F, default: D) -> U;
}

--- Text 160 ---
option-ext 0.2.0 unmodified corresponding source: src/impl.rs

use OptionExt;

impl<T> OptionExt<T> for Option<T> {
    fn contains<U>(&self, x: &U) -> bool where U: PartialEq<T> {
        match *self {
            Some(ref y) => x == y,
            None => false,
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    fn map_or2<U, F: FnOnce(T) -> U>(self, f: F, default: U) -> U {
        self.map_or(default, f)
    }

    #[inline]
    fn map_or_else2<U, F: FnOnce(T) -> U, D: FnOnce() -> U>(self, f: F, default: D) -> U {
        self.map_or_else(default, f)
    }
}
